mascot: Vivi the Fox — a clever fox with five bright balloons shaped like the vowels a, e, i, o, u.

slides.title: Meet the Vowels 👋
slides.text: English has 26 letters, but 5 are super special: a, e, i, o, u! They are the vowels. Every word uses at least one vowel!
slides.spoken: A, E, I, O, U are the vowels. Every word needs a vowel!

slides.title: Short and Long Vowels 🎈
slides.text: Vowels can sound short or long! In 'cat' the a is short: a-a-cat. In 'cake' the a says its own name: A! That is a long a.
slides.spoken: In cat the a is short. In cake the a says its name — long a!

slides.title: The Magic e ✨
slides.text: Magic e at the end of a word makes the vowel say its name! cap becomes cape, kit becomes kite, hop becomes hope. Magic!
slides.spoken: Magic e makes the vowel say its name: cap to cape, kit to kite!

slides.title: Vowel Teams 🤝
slides.text: Two vowels can team up! ai in rain, ee in bee, oa in boat. When two vowels go walking, the first one does the talking!
slides.spoken: Ai in rain, ee in bee, oa in boat — vowel teams!

slides.title: Listen Carefully 👂
slides.text: Close your eyes and listen: is the vowel sound short or long? Is it a, e, i, o, u? You are a vowel detective now!
slides.spoken: Listen closely! Is the vowel short or long? Which vowel is it?

challenges.question: Which letter is a vowel?
challenges.hint: The vowels are a, e, i, o, u. Find one in the choices!
challenges.misconception: E is a vowel! B and m are consonants.

challenges.question: How many vowels does English have?
challenges.hint: Count them on one hand: a, e, i, o, u!
challenges.misconception: English has exactly 5 vowels: a, e, i, o, u!

challenges.question: Which word has the LONG 'a' sound (a says its own name)?
challenges.hint: Say each word. In which one do you hear the letter name A?
challenges.misconception: In cake the a says its name — long a! In cat and cap the a is short.

challenges.question: In 'cake', which letter at the end makes 'a' say its name?
challenges.hint: C-a-k-e. Which quiet letter works its magic from the end?
challenges.misconception: The magic e at the end makes the a long — cake! Without it, it would be 'cak'.

challenges.question: Which vowel is in the middle of 'sun'?
challenges.hint: S-u-n. The letter in the middle is one of the five vowels!
challenges.misconception: The middle letter of sun is u — s, u, n!

challenges.question: Which word has the 'ee' sound like in 'see'?
challenges.hint: Bee, bed, bet — one of them buzzes with the long e!
challenges.misconception: Bee has the ee sound — b-EE! Bed and bet have short e.

challenges.question: Drag each word! Is the 'a' sound long or short?
challenges.hint: Cake and rain say the name A. Cat and map say a short a!
challenges.misconception: Cake (magic e) and Rain (ai team) have long a. Cat and Map have short a!

challenges.question: Drag each word! Does it have the 'oa' sound like in 'boat'?
challenges.hint: Boat and goat have the oa team. Bee and hand do not!
challenges.misconception: Boat and Goat have the oa sound. Bee has ee, and hand has a short a!
